company.name: Udora
company.shortDescription: Udora is a fast-growing gifting platform connecting customers with local sellers.
company.description:
Udora is a fast-growing gifting platform connecting customers with local florists, confectioners, and artisan makers across 50+ countries and 1,500+ cities, including MENA, UK, Spain and LATAM. The startup combines personalized technology with a human touch to modernize one of the world's most traditional retail verticals. 

Putting sellers at the heart of our business, we provide them access to a loyal and paying worldwide audience. Innovative tools together with marketing instruments help local businesses from 50+ countries scale and promote their products. That's our core value in making small businesses closer to customers both locally and abroad. We equally want to help a friend from London surprise their loved ones in Abu Dhabi, or a student in Dubai send a birthday gift to his grandma in Madrid.
For customers, we provide a one-stop solution to find the perfect gift with ease and convenience: same-day delivery, product photos before delivery, a calendar of important dates, and curated collections from local shops. People worldwide can surprise their loved ones with flowers, confectionery, craft and handmade items, plants, and jewellery from local makers across 1,500+ cities. https://udora.ae/
